g.title: registry->items
g.text: all registered content references valid item identities/capabilities

g.title: registry->fluids
g.text: fluid/container registries are cross-validated before world start

g.title: registry->construction
g.text: construction content/profile consistency is validated at registry initialization

g.title: world_physics
g.text: Shared terrain height + occupancy + airspace physics

g.title: world_physics->surface
g.text: shared terrain physics interpolates deterministic global world height

g.title: world_physics->construction
g.text: shared world occupancy treats lightweight construction as physical geometry

g.title: geology->surface
g.text: cave mouths and subsurface depth are anchored to the authoritative surface/water world

g.title: survival->surface
g.text: respiration queries authoritative water depth instead of renderer state

g.title: nutrition->fluids
g.text: actor drinking resolves typed fluids/containers through the fluid registry

g.title: flora->territory_policy
g.text: wild flora is exploitable only with territorial access

g.title: flora->surface
g.text: growth/irrigation use the same terrain moisture authority

g.title: flora->geology
g.text: surface mineral exposures are materialized only when backed by deterministic subsurface ore bodies

g.title: fauna->items
g.text: diets and loot resolve item identities

g.title: fauna->surface
g.text: spawn/migration/foraging/drinking are constrained by the authoritative habitat surface

g.title: interactions->nutrition
g.text: consume action uses generic food authority

g.title: interactions->fluids
g.text: fill/drink/irrigate dispatch uses typed fluid payloads and container capabilities

g.title: interactions->construction
g.text: universal interaction dispatch places and dismantles lightweight construction

g.title: construction->territory_policy
g.text: placement and dismantling rights derive from territorial control

g.title: construction->surface
g.text: construction placement rejects water/steep invalid surfaces

g.title: persistence->survival
g.text: worldgen version and respiration state survive save/load through save schema migrations

g.title: persistence->fauna
g.text: fauna and nests survive save/load rather than respawning as decoration

g.title: persistence->construction
g.text: save20 persists compact construction topology and durability while explicit migrations preserve legacy artifact-backed blocks

g.title: simulation->surface
g.text: movement uses terrain authority rather than renderer geometry

g.title: simulation->world_physics
g.text: actor movement and camera consume shared physical occupancy geometry

g.title: simulation->survival
g.text: respiration and environmental damage advance in the authoritative world tick

g.title: simulation->nutrition
g.text: actor survival ticks through generic nutrition

g.title: simulation->fluids
g.text: bot survival drinks real carried fluids and navigates to physical water sources

g.title: simulation->flora
g.text: flora lifecycle runs in authoritative world tick

g.title: simulation->fauna
g.text: fauna lifecycle runs in authoritative world tick

g.title: simulation->artifacts
g.text: death can create persistent recovery container

g.title: renderer->surface
g.text: visual ground/water/orientation use same terrain height/normal

g.title: renderer->construction
g.text: native renderer draws authoritative compact construction state

g.title: flutter_host->surface
g.text: APK can inspect authoritative terrain/weather state

g.title: flutter_host->geology
g.text: APK can inspect authoritative cave/ore strata through the C API

g.title: flutter_host->survival
g.text: APK reads oxygen/worldgen state from C without duplicating survival rules

g.title: flutter_host->nutrition
g.text: APK exposes actor satiety/hydration without duplicating survival rules

g.title: flutter_host->fluids
g.text: APK consumes fluid and container definitions from the C authority

g.title: flutter_host->fauna
g.text: APK consumes fauna + nest snapshots and habitat definitions

g.title: flutter_host->persistence
g.text: APK stores independent named world slots, verifies integrity, and asks the C save-schema authority whether a world is loadable; API/ABI are provenance only

g.title: wasm_host->game_api
g.text: preview export surface is derived from native ABI allowlist

g.title: architecture_guards->flora
g.text: transversal gameplay cannot hardcode concrete flora species/items
